name: AlignUI
summary: Freemium React/Tailwind/Radix design system; Base Components are free MIT copy-paste.

install.command: Copy Base Component source from https://alignui.com/docs/v1.2/ui/{name} (optional tokens: npx @alignui/cli tailwind)

gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~49 free AlignUI Base Components under /docs/v1.2/ui/*.
Components & Blocks / Sectoral Templates / Figma File are PRO — not ingested (proOnly false Base only).
Install is copy-paste from docs (or starter template); @alignui/cli only scaffolds Tailwind v4.1 tokens.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primary action button with variants, sizes, and polymorphic icons.
components.copyCode:
# AlignUI Base Component (MIT free) — copy source from docs
# Docs: https://alignui.com/docs/v1.2/ui/button
npm install @radix-ui/react-slot

# 1) Optional tokens: npx @alignui/cli tailwind
# 2) Copy `Button` source from the docs page into your components/ui dir
# Starter with all base comps: https://github.com/alignui/alignui-nextjs-typescript-starter

copyPrompt.text: Use AlignUI free MIT Base Component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://alignui.com/docs/v1.2/ui/button. Copy/paste source from the docs (Base Components are FREE MIT; Pro covers blocks/templates/Figma). Optional Tailwind tokens: `npx @alignui/cli tailwind`. Home: https://alignui.com. License: MIT (https://www.alignui.com/license; starter Copyright (c) 2024 Doğukan Çavuş). Pricing freemium (ingest free Base only).
